description: This file contains utility functions and logic for managing local heavy check locks, environment configuration, and process synchronization used within a software project, likely related to development environment management and process control.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the local check is enabled based on the environment variable OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Determines if a specific flag or argument is present in the provided argument list.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies the arguments and environment for local tsgo policy application, adding specific flags and environment variables if local check is enabled.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Modifies arguments and environment for local oxlint policy application, adding relevant flags and environment variables.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously acquires a lock for performing heavy checks locally, managing lock ownership, handling stale locks, and timing out if the lock cannot be acquired within a specified period.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the Git common directory for a given working directory by executing a git command or defaulting to the .git directory.
